briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate frontier race with simultaneous model drops amid rising safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as major labs release next-generation models while regulatory scrutiny grows. Funding remains robust with strategic investments in infrastructure. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; xAI launched Grok-3; Anthropic deployed Claude 4 Opus. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 sparking industry debate. DeepSeek advanced multimodal capabilities.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Google expanded TPU v6 clusters; NVIDIA reported record H200 demand. New data center projects announced in Texas and Arizona totaling 5GW capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed labs by end of 2026?
